name: NEON//GRID
author: Marinara Engine
description: Black glass terminal over a rain-slick neon city. Cyan corner brackets on whatever has focus, one neon tube under the top bar, a 70-character reading column for long replies with a pinned speaker line. Finished day (dawn) and night looks; follows the time of day. No HTML needed.

fonts.credit: VT323 by Peter Hull, renamed for this theme
Share Tech Mono by Carrois Apostrophe, renamed for this theme

credits.what: Backdrops (city night and day, phone night and day, game corridor), top-bar strip and rain tile

credits.what: Corner brackets, hex grid, cursor, Home line icons, user tile, send icon
